area: Social policy and old-age provision (AHV/social security)
description: Prominent advocate for strengthening old-age and survivors' insurance; member of the National Council Commission for Social Security and Health and a leading SP voice for the 13th AHV pension.
Campaigned as SP co-president for the Premium Relief Initiative, calling for premiums to be capped at 10 percent of disposable income.

area: Tax justice and distribution of wealth
description: Advocates progressive taxation and the taxation of large fortunes and corporations; involved in international tax-justice networks (Global Alliance for Tax Justice, ICRICT).

Long-standing engagement on asylum and undocumented-migrant issues; co-president of the National Platform for Undocumented Migrants and former board member of the Zurich counselling centre SPAZ; advocates a welcoming approach to asylum seekers.
Engagement on equality issues through the Frauenzentrale Zurich and Helvetiarockt; began her career with an internship at the Zurich cantonal equality office.
Member of the Unia and VPOD trade unions and close ties to the Swiss Federation of Trade Unions (SGB) network.
Advisory-board member of Internetcafe Planet 13, a meeting place by and for people affected by poverty.
